title: The Code of Theseus: Can Agents Rebuild Software from Recovered Design Documents?
abstract: arXiv:2610.20068v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM agents increasingly design a system before implementing it, yet the data to train and evaluate them centres on implementation and testing: requirements and design artefacts are often missing, outdated or private. Source code, in contrast, is abundant. Prior work recovers architecture documentation by feeding LLMs the source code or letting agents explore it, which saturates the context, does not scale to many repositories, and yields a single artefact rather than aligned ones.   We present a framework that recovers aligned stakeholder intent, requirements and architecture from a compact repository representation, a static dependency graph and key contextual files, and release the artefacts of 10,764 Java, Python, C/C++ and C# repositories as a dataset. translated_title: 忒修斯之代码：智能体能否依据恢复的设计文档重建软件？
translated_abstract: LLM 智能体越来越多地在实现系统之前先进行设计，然而用于训练和评估它们的数据却集中在实现与测试上：需求与设计工件常常缺失、过时或属于私有。相比之下，源代码却十分丰富。以往的工作通过将源代码直接输入 LLM 或让智能体探索源代码来恢复架构文档，但这会耗尽上下文窗口、难以扩展到大量仓库，且只能产出单个工件而非相互对齐的一组工件。我们提出了一个框架，能够从紧凑的仓库表示、静态依赖图和关键上下文文件中恢复相互对齐的利益相关者意图、需求与架构，并发布了来自 10,764 个 Java、Python、C/C++ 和 C# 仓库的工件作为数据集。LLM 评审认为三个生成器产出的工件清晰且内部一致，但在正确性和恰当的抽象层级方面可靠性较低。为检验这些工件是否（摘要原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 提出一个从紧凑仓库表示中恢复相互对齐的意图、需求与架构文档的框架，并发布覆盖 10,764 个多语言仓库的工件数据集，用于研究智能体能否凭借恢复的设计文档重建软件。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a framework that recovers aligned stakeholder intent, requirements, and architecture documents from a compact repository representation, and releases a dataset spanning 10,764 multi-language repositories to test whether agents can rebuild software from the recovered design documents.
